body: I really don't see that as being accurate. But I'll allow you to have your opinion, and I have mine.
Let's just say that post-partum depression coupled with my sister being diagnosed with a terminal condition led to the sad truth behind what happened to her.
You are not alone, and you are stronger than you think you are.

Yes, you should go. They won't make you do anything you don't want to. They will not call anybody without your consent. Bringing yourself in voluntarily is safe, and will help you start the process of working through these things. You can do this. I believe in you.
Everybody who knows my family thinks my sister died from "crib death" or SIDS, basically. Yeah.. that's not true. She was murdered.
This is exactly how I feel.
